{{Quote|We're leavin' without the spice?|Barb Mentir, as he and Turk Falso prepare to escape Florrum|audio=MentirWithoutTheSpice-TGG.flac|<ref name="TCWGungan" />}}
'''Barb Mentir''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] and a member of [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's]] [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]]&ndash;[[Hondo's complex/Legends|based]] [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirate gang]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Mentir cooperated with fellow gang member [[Turk Falso/Legends|Turk Falso]] to betray Ohnaka, who had captured [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], the [[Head of State/Legends|leader]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Ohnaka planned to hand the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] over to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] in exchange for a ransom in the form of [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. Falso betrayed Ohnaka and ordered Mentir to shoot down the Republic [[Kharrus's Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class shuttle]] that was carrying the ransom over Florrum so that they could steal the spice. Mentir succeeded in shooting the [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] down, but failed to [[Death/Legends|kill]] its passengers or obtain the spice. After Falso fell short in his own endeavor to claim the ransom, he and Mentir attempted to escape in a [[Unidentified Flarestar-class attack shuttle (Barb Mentir)/Legends|''Flarestar''-class attack shuttle]]. However, Dooku used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|choke]] Falso and manipulated him to shoot Mentir in the chest, killing him.

==Biography==
{{Quote|They crashed into Doshar fields.''"<br />"''Good. Good! Then you have the spice?''"<br />"''No&hellip;not exactly, no. I think there are survivors, uh&hellip;we have to call it off. Maybe we should tell Hondo.|Barb Mentir reports his failure to Turk Falso|audio=MentirCallItOff-TGG.flac|<ref name="TCWGungan" />}}
[[File:FalsoMentir-TGG.png|thumb|left|200px|Falso and Mentir discuss the plan to steal the spice ransom.]]
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]], Barb Mentir was a member of [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's]] [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirate gang]], based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]].<ref name="TCWGungan" /> Some five [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Mentir was involved in a [[Knife/Legends|knife]] fight, where he lost his right [[Eye/Legends|eye]]. Afterward, he wore an [[Eye patch/Legends|eye patch]] to cover the empty socket.<ref name="GDecoded">{{TCW|The Gungan General|d=y}}</ref> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Head of State/Legends|leader]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] crash-landed on the planet [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]]. After eluding capture by two pursuing [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Dooku encountered some members of Ohnaka's gang. Ohnaka managed to take the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] captive and transported him to his [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]' [[Hondo's complex/Legends|base of operations]] on Florrum. Ohnaka then contacted [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and agreed to release Dooku into Republic custody for a hefty ransom of [[Spice/Legends|spice]].<ref name="TCWDookuCaptured">{{TCW|Dooku Captured}}</ref>

After discussing the ransom with Ohnaka, [[Turk Falso/Legends|Turk Falso]],<ref name="TCWGungan" /> the group's second-in-command,<ref name="GDecoded" /> met with Mentir and told him that the spice was on the way. Falso ordered Mentir to shoot down the [[Kharrus's Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|Republic shuttle]]&mdash;which was transporting the spice&mdash;with his ship, being careful to not damage the spice itself. Mentir felt the plan was too risky and asked him about Ohnaka, but Falso allayed his fears and claimed that they would be long gone before Ohnaka realized what had happened. Mentir then took a [[Unidentified Flarestar-class attack shuttle (Barb Mentir)/Legends|''Flarestar''-class attack shuttle]] and waited in Florrum's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] for the arrival of the Republic [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. After sighting the vessel, he first opened fire on it with his [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], and then fired a pair of [[Missile/Legends|missiles]], forcing the craft down.<ref name="TCWGungan" />

Mentir returned to the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] base, where he reported to Falso. Mentir informing Falso that the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] had crashed in the [[Doshar fields/Legends|Doshar fields]], but due to suspected survivors, he had failed to obtain the spice. The pirate balked at completing the mission, wanting instead to reveal to Ohnaka what they had done, but Falso threw him to the ground and ordered him not to do so. Falso then took a group of cohorts to recover the spice himself, but was repelled by the surviving Republic [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. Falso lied to Ohnaka, telling him that the Republic had sent an army instead of a ransom. Hoping to escape the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] aboard a ''Flarestar''-class vessel, Falso found Mentir, who questioned if they would leave without the spice. Falso replied that it would not be long until Ohnaka discovered their treachery. Not realizing that Dooku had sneaked up behind them, Falso was [[Telekinesis/Legends|choked and manipulated]] into aiming his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] at Mentir and shooting him in the chest, [[Death/Legends|killing]] him.<ref name="TCWGungan" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|It's too risky. What about Hondo?|Mentir, unsure of Falso's plan|audio=MentirWhatAboutHondo-TGG.flac|<ref name="TCWGungan" />}}
[[File:Barb_Mentir_shot.png|thumb|right|250px|Mentir is killed by a blaster shot to the chest.]]
Mentir followed the orders given by Falso, but he also questioned him, especially when they lost the spice. He feared Ohnaka, going as far as to suggesting that they should tell him about their deception. Mentir was a pilot skilled enough to fly a ''Flarestar''-class ship and shoot down a ''Nu''-class shuttle piloted by experienced [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilots]]. Mentir had [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and brown skin.<ref name="TCWGungan" />

==Behind the scenes==
Barb Mentir first appeared as an unidentified pirate in "[[The Gungan General]]," the twelfth episode of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' television series]], which aired on [[January 9]], [[2009]].<ref name="TCWGungan" /> The character was identified by name in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars#Decoded|''Decoded'']] re-airing of the episode.<ref name="GDecoded" /> Mentir was voiced by [[James Arnold Taylor]], who also provides the voice of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] throughout the series.<ref name="The Gungan General Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode012.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Gungan General}}</ref> In the [[2011]] non-[[canon]] video game ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'', in the level that adapts "The Gungan General," the Republic shuttle is shot down by a Weequay pirate in the opening cutscene. However, the pilot is not identified as Mentir, and the game actually uses the model of [[Shahan Alama/Legends|Shahan Alama]] to represent the Weequay.
